estimates.assumptions: 1 typical garlic clove weighs ~5g peeled; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw garlic.

A standard bunch of parsley is ~25-30g of usable leaves after removing thick stems; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw parsley. Half is used chopped in step 1, half scattered at end, but grams reflect whole bunch as listed.
1 teaspoon of vinegar is ~5g; sherry vinegar has ~20 kcal/100g as a very low-calorie acidic liquid.
'To serve' is not a quantified recipe ingredient with mass or calories; no reasonable estimate possible without assuming arbitrary serving size.
